cameraInstructions: Film from the side with the full body, hips, knees, and feet visible.

metrics.targetText: Keep the upper body upright while lifting the knees.
metrics.hint_good: Your upper body stayed tall while the legs moved.
metrics.hint_high: Your body rocked forward. Look ahead and keep the chest lifted.

metrics.targetText: Land each foot close to underneath the hips.
metrics.hint_good: Your foot returned close to underneath the hips.
metrics.hint_low: The foot landed too far behind. Keep the steps underneath your body.
metrics.hint_high: The foot reached too far forward. Land softly underneath the hips.

metrics.targetText: Lift each knee close to hip height.
metrics.hint_good: Your knees reached a clear height.
metrics.hint_low: Lift the knee a little higher while keeping the body tall.
metrics.hint_high: Keep the knee lift controlled instead of pulling it too high.

metrics.targetText: Lift each knee to a similar height.
metrics.hint_good: Your knee lifts reached a similar height.
metrics.hint_high: The knee height changed between steps. Aim for one repeatable height.

metrics.targetText: Keep the alternating steps at an even rhythm.
metrics.hint_good: Your steps followed a steady rhythm.
metrics.hint_high: The rhythm changed between steps. Keep one comfortable beat.
